# What quantize.py runs under, every package pinned, transitive ones included.
# With exactly these, on Python 3.12, it reproduces the shipped
# reranker-int8.onnx byte for byte - checked against release.sha256 by the
# release workflow. A different onnxruntime is a different quantiser.
#
# Every file each pin may resolve to carries its hash, so pip installs these
# wheels and no others. To move a pin, write the bare `name==version` lines to
# a file and regenerate from it:
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.12 \
#       --no-header --no-annotate pins.in -o requirements.txt
